dataset.name: Metagenome and metatranscriptome data for Rifle CMT-03 laboratory microcosm experiment completed in April 2014
description: Sediment samples were collected during installation of monitoring borehole CMT-03. Microcosms were constructed and inoculated under anerobic conditions with these sediments and anaerobic Rifle artificial groundwater. Microcosm metagenomes and metatranscriptomes were sampled every 5 days for a period of 20 days. The dataset gives gene-level annotations, binning, metagenomic and metatranscriptomic coverages for these microcosms.

spatialCoverage.description: Site: Rifle, Colorado US-RIF, Well: CMT-03The Rifle site is located in the east side of the Upper Colorado River Basin (UCRB) in northwestern Colorado. The site had a former uranium and vanadium mill, which operated between 1924 and 1958. As a uranium‐contaminated site it has been the focus of several intense hydrological, biogeochemical, and bioremediation research activities., and was used by the DOE Sustainable Systems Scientific Focus Area to explore how climate drivers influence hydrological processes and biogeochemical cycling within the Colorado River Basin. The Rifle site is located atop a floodplain adjacent to the Colorado River floodplain systems within the UCRB, and is representative of floodplains in the UCRB based upon its overall aquifer properties and hydrological coupling to the Colorado River.
